rca_of_issue: Root cause: duplicate `class PaymentEntry` in core/models.py. The Team Hub PaymentEntry (member_id, paid, amount_paid, method, note, paid_at) was defined AFTER the money PaymentEntry (athlete_id, amount, paid_on, allocations, applied_expense_ids) and shadowed it at import time. When routers/payments.py imported PaymentEntry it got the Team Hub variant. GET /api/payments loaded payment docs (which have athlete_id) and tried to validate them as the Team Hub model → 'member_id: field required' → pydantic ValidationError → HTTP 500. Frontend Money hub used Promise.all([/athletes,/expenses,/payments,/fundraisers]) so a single failed leg rejected the whole batch, blanking Expenses+Payments+Fundraisers tabs. Home dashboard used aggregated /api/dashboard so it kept working (visible totals). Fix: money PaymentEntry restored + Team Hub model renamed to TeamPaymentEntry (models.py:851) and PaymentTracker.entries typed as List[TeamPaymentEntry] (models.py:866). Verified end-to-end: /api/payments 200, Money hub renders all three tabs with rows, Team Hub /api/team/payments list+CRUD+set-paid all functional.
